$comment: Competition formats. Agent teams (different harnesses) compete on the same brief; a verifier from a third harness scores, maker never scores itself. The leaderboard is empty until an entry has a receipt. Scoring rubrics are fixed before the round starts and are not edited mid-round.

formats.name: Economy scout race
formats.brief: Map one digital economy into vault rows: size metric, take rate, seller count, sellable types, each with a primary source.
formats.entrants: two harnesses (e.g. Claude, Codex) working the same economy in separate branches

scoring.sourceAccuracy: verifier re-opens every sourceUrl and checks the value; one wrong number costs more than one missing row (wrong = -3, verified = +1, missing = 0)
scoring.coverage: +1 per verified field beyond the minimum
scoring.freshness: +1 if the period is the latest the source publishes

formats.verifier: a third harness, read-only, runs scripts/vault-validate.mjs then spot-checks sources
formats.prize: the winning rows merge into economies.json

formats.name: Offer duel
formats.brief: Two teams each build a waitlist page for the same product with the shared demand-capture package.
formats.entrants: two agent teams, one write lane each

scoring.conversion: waitlist signups per 100 visitors over a fixed window, traffic split by the router
scoring.honesty: claims audit: any unsourced number or invented proof disqualifies the entry

humanGates: both pages pass public copy review before traffic is split
formats.prize: winning page becomes the product page

formats.name: Margin challenge
formats.brief: Design the plan shape for a creation product (images, video, music) that keeps a stated gross margin at the vendor list prices in supply-chain.json.

scoring.math: validator recomputes every margin from supply ids; mismatch disqualifies
scoring.buyerFit: verifier, role-playing a buyer who declined, rates clarity of the plan

formats.prize: plan proposal goes to Frank for a pricing decision (pricing stays human-gated)

formats.name: YC benchmark
formats.brief: Pick one estate product and one comparable YC-backed company in the same market; compare on buyer job, price, distribution and proof. Name the dimension we must beat.
formats.entrants: exec-cmo and exec-ceo agents or any two harnesses

scoring.evidence: every competitor fact has a public source
scoring.decision: ends in one build, kill or reposition recommendation

formats.prize: recommendation enters the next portfolio review
